en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a coastal town with a harbor in the foreground and low mountains in the background. Small boats lie in the bay, with quays, piers, and a few waterfront buildings visible. The town climbs the hillside with whitewashed houses and several prominent church domes and bell towers. There is a green postage stamp with a flying bird in the upper-left corner. Printed captions run along the right and bottom edges, and there is cursive handwriting on the right side. A faint watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears over the image.
